svg.title: Methodology overview board with eight steps
svg.desc: An eight-step vertical board: data source, corpus design, sentence level, representation, topic discovery, linguistic layer, close reading, and interpretation, banded into preparation, modelling, and interpretation phases.
svg.text: Computational topic discovery and linguistic interpretation

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Step 1: the German doctor reviews data source from 2021')
sendPrompt('Step 2: corpus design with a stratified, rating-balanced sample')
sendPrompt('Step 4: German contextual embeddings with GottBERT')
sendPrompt('Step 7: close reading with representative sentences and dependency parses')
sendPrompt('Step 8: integrated interpretation of topics and patient stance')
